'''Frozencavern Canyon''' was an ice ravine in the northeastern corner of [[the Tomb]], an ancient Rakata [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].The [[deep caverns]], [[frozen transport center]], and the [[Rakata machine caves]] were all located in the canyon, and it was linked to the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] by a passageway carved into the western wall of the ravine.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frozencavern Canyon is a location in the Tomb on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
